phase1_cpg_meqtl_mapping.unit: CpG-SNP pair within region-specific cis windows
phase1_cpg_meqtl_mapping.formula: CpG_methylation ~ SNP_dosage + age + sex + diagnosis + ancestry_PCs + technical_covariates + validated_latent_factors
phase1_cpg_meqtl_mapping.notes: Validated latent factors are included only if calibration improves without removing genetic signal.

phase1_vmr_meqtl_burden.formula: meqtl_burden ~ continuous_predictability + n_cpg + mean_methylation + methylation_variance + mean_coverage + vmr_length + cpg_density + local_snp_density + mean_testable_maf + mappability + repeat_overlap + genomic_annotation + brain_region + effective_sample_size

schizophrenia_mean_region.analysis_tier: primary for caudate, secondary for DLPFC and hippocampus
schizophrenia_mean_region.formula: VMR_methylation ~ diagnosis + age + sex + ancestry_PCs + technical_covariates + cell_covariates

schizophrenia_shared_region.unit: shared VMR methylation across repeated donor-region samples
schizophrenia_shared_region.formula: VMR_methylation ~ diagnosis * region + age + sex + ancestry_PCs + technical_covariates + cell_covariates + (1 | donor)

aging_linear_region.formula: VMR_methylation ~ age + sex + diagnosis + ancestry_PCs + technical_covariates + cell_covariates

aging_spline_region.formula: VMR_methylation ~ rcs(age, df = 3) + sex + diagnosis + ancestry_PCs + technical_covariates + cell_covariates

aging_shared_region.unit: shared VMR methylation across repeated donor-region samples
aging_shared_region.formula: VMR_methylation ~ age * region + diagnosis + sex + ancestry_PCs + technical_covariates + cell_covariates + (1 | donor)
